senses.gloss: (√בל, v. בָּלַל; cmp. פלט, מלט, ולד; cmp. Assyr. בלט to live, Schr. KAT gloss. I, II)
(neut. v.) to stand forth, project; to be cut in relief, opp. שקע to sink, be engraven.
units: <cite ref="Rosh Hashanah 24b:10">R. Hash. 24ᵇ</cite> <he>טבעת שחותמה בּוֹלֵט</he> Ms. M. (ed. incorr.) a ring whose seal is cut in relief; <cite ref="Jerusalem Talmud Avodah Zarah 3:1:20">Y. Ab. Zar. III, 42ᶜ</cite> bot.
<cite ref="Mishnah Sotah 3:4">Sot. III, 4</cite> <he>עיניה בוֹלְטוֹת</he> her eyes protruded; <cite ref="Bamidbar Rabbah 9">Num. R. s. 9</cite>.—
<cite ref="Yoma 54a:10">Yoma 54ᵃ</cite> <he>דוחקין ובולטין</he> pressing forth and protruding (from behind the curtain); a. fr.
<cite ref="Jerusalem Talmud Shabbat 12:4:4">Y. Sabb. XII, 13ᵈ</cite> <he>בבולט מקום הכתב וכ׳</he> when he beats out the place of writing, opp. <he>חוקק</he>.
